build_FPN: build a Feature Pyramid Network module that adds FPN on top of a list of feature maps
create_FPN_forward: create a forward pass through FPN layers that returns feature maps ordered from highest resolution first
test_LastLevelMaxPool: test the LastLevelMaxPool module that applies max pooling to generate an additional lower-resolution feature level
review_LastLevelP6P7: review the LastLevelP6P7 module used in RetinaNet to generate extra P6 and P7 layers
summarize_FPN_top_blocks: summarize the FPN top_blocks parameter that performs extra operations on the last FPN output
